steps: rm -rf {W} && git clone -q /work/in/main.bundle {W} && cd {W} && git checkout -q -B main {commit} && git remote remove origin && rm -f /work/in/main.bundle && git rev-parse HEAD
cd {W}/services/hyperfide && npm ci --ignore-scripts >/work/logs/npm-ci.log 2>&1 && npm run build >/work/logs/npm-build.log 2>&1 && ls dist | head -1

cd {W}/platform && ((corepack enable --install-directory /usr/local/bin && corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.0 --activate) >/work/logs/pnpm-g.log 2>&1 || (npm i -g pnpm@9.15.0 && mise reshim) >>/work/logs/pnpm-g.log 2>&1) && pnpm -v && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >/work/logs/pnpm-install.log 2>&1 && tail -3 /work/logs/pnpm-install.log && du -sh node_modules | cut -f1
cd {W}/platform && (pnpm build >/work/logs/pnpm-build.log 2>&1 && echo build_ok || (echo build_failed; tail -30 /work/logs/pnpm-build.log))
codex --version && /usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin/initdb --version && node -v && python3 --version && git --version && pnpm -v && df -h /work | tail -1

prepare: make -j"$(nproc)" cg >/work/out/{S}.prepare.log 2>&1 && (git diff --quiet {checkpointCommit} HEAD -- services/hyperfide/package-lock.json || npm --prefix services/hyperfide ci --ignore-scripts >>/work/out/{S}.prepare.log 2>&1) && npm --prefix services/hyperfide run build >>/work/out/{S}.prepare.log 2>&1 && (git diff --quiet {checkpointCommit} HEAD -- platform/pnpm-lock.yaml platform/pnpm-workspace.yaml || (cd platform && (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >>/work/out/{S}.prepare.log 2>&1 || pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile >>/work/out/{S}.prepare.log 2>&1)))

qualify.cmd: (./cg spec start -f {feature} {task} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); HYPERFIDE_PG_BIN=/usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin CG_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS=300000 python3 tests/hyperfide/support/withpg.py -- ./cg spec done -f {feature} {task}
